headline: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World is almost here
title: Dragon Quest Monsters The Withered World December 3 | Bianca and Nera | Gaming News
video_script: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World launches worldwide on December third, twenty twenty six. It comes to Nintendo Switch 2, Switch, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, and PC. The story follows Bianca and Nera from Dragon Quest five as monster wranglers. A free demo is already available, and your saved progress can carry over to the full game. Will you be collecting monsters? Comment below!
